title: Company incorporation (SPICe+)
summary: Reserve the company name and incorporate the company through the MCA SPICe+ web form. PAN, TAN and DINs are allotted with the Certificate of Incorporation.

eligibility.text: Every company incorporated with effect from 23rd February, 2020 is required to make an application for reservation of name and incorporation through the web service SPICe+.

sources.title: Instruction Kit for webform SPICe+ Part A (Name Reservation)
Instruction Kit for Form No. SPICe + Part B
FAQs on Incorporation and Allied Matters

steps.title: File SPICe+ (name reservation and incorporation)
steps.description: Fill SPICe+ Part A (name) and Part B (incorporation), file the linked forms (e-MOA, e-AOA, AGILE-PRO-S), affix the DSCs, upload and pay. Part A and Part B can be filed together or Part A first.
steps.department: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Central Registration Centre

documents.name: Director PAN (or Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence number if no PAN)
documents.note: Entered in Part B and verified against the PAN database; can be fetched from DigiLocker.

documents.name: Digital signature certificate (DSC)
documents.note: Must be registered on the MCA portal and valid (not expired or revoked).

documents.name: Registered office address proof (utility bill)
documents.note: Must match the address in the form; English translation if the bill is in a vernacular language.

documents.name: NOC from the owner of the premises
documents.note: Must name the proposed company and be given by the owner.

documents.name: Lease deed or rent agreement (rented premises)

fee.note: Depends on authorised share capital; stamp duty differs by state. Zero filing fee up to ₹15,00,000 authorised capital. PAN ₹66, TAN ₹65. ₹1,000 if the name is reserved separately (Part A).

officialSla.note: No processing time is stated in the reviewed MCA sources (Part A and Part B are processed in Non-STP mode).

review.note: Values quoted from the MCA kits and FAQs; check each row on the live pages.

steps.title: Company incorporated
steps.description: Certificate of Incorporation issued with CIN; PAN and TAN allotted; DINs issued to directors who did not have one.
